# Devpost fixtures

SYNTHETIC. The agent proxy blocked devpost.com during the first build session, so
these files are hand-written to follow Devpost's known markup (class names such as
`gallery-item`, `winner label`, `software-team-member`, `cp-tag`). Names, projects and
URLs are invented (example.test). They test parser logic only. Replace/augment with
sanitized real captures in task L1 and re-validate selectors.
